# Tone rules

- calm, not melodramatic
- direct, not abstract
- grounded in institutions, dates, and consequences
- politically informed, not slogan-heavy
- readable in a game event card

## Examples of phrases to prefer

- “The village gathered around the radio and shared its fears late into the night.”
- “The father wrapped the land deeds in oilcloth and hid them in a wooden chest.”
- “The family went out to its fields as usual; the season waits for no one.”

## Examples to avoid

- “This historic turning point changed the destiny of the nation.”
- “The world watched in horror as...”
- generic AI filler with no concrete action or event
